thread:
Maya Chen: Quick sync — we need X + LinkedIn scheduling for the webinar next week. 3-post drip and one thread for X. Two creative variants (GIF hero + static). Timing idea: Wed 9am PT teaser, Thu 11am PT main, Fri 9am PT reminder. Need copy + assets by Mon EOD. :rocket:
Luca Ramirez: Sounds good. Do we have the landing page variant and UTM params? I want to test a benchmark narrative CTA vs product-first CTA.
Samir Patel: I can draft 3 copy variants: benchmark narrative (cost/latency win), product-first (what it does), and customer-story (who's using it). Will post in here by EOD Mon.
Nicole O'Neil: For X thread, let's do 4 tweets: opener (stat), short explainer, demo gif, CTA w/ webinar link. Also need first comment with expanded links + TL;DR. Make sure UTM has campaign=social_webinar and source param set.
Ava (Design): I can deliver 2 hero GIFs (1080x1080) and 2 static images (1200x628) by Mon 3pm PT. Any preferences on motion? prefer subtle KV cache animation or a product UI pan?
Maya Chen: subtle KV cache animation is perfect — ties to performance story. Also add an alt-text line for accessibility.
Luca Ramirez: For UTMs: ?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=social_webinar&utm_content={variant}. For linkedIn, change source=linkedin. Also add a short hash for org tracking: &org=redwood.
Samir Patel: Copy drafts: 1) "Webinar: Reduce inference cost 2x without latency tradeoffs — watch how teams optimize batching + caching." 2) "How top ML teams get predictable latency at scale — join our webinar." 3) "Customer X cut token costs by 43% — join the walkthrough." Which tone do we prefer? casual or authoritative?
Nicole O'Neil: Authoritative for the main post, casual for teaser. For LinkedIn carousel, we'll lead with the benchmark stat then quick steps.
Ava (Design): Uploading 2 mock GIFs to /shared/marketing/assets/webinar_0412/ in a bit. Will include a 280-character alt text file.
social-bot: Reminder scheduled: Please add final assets & copy by Mon 5pm PT or scheduling will slip.
Maya Chen: Also want a 30s clip for LinkedIn stories — can we squeeze it?
Ava (Design): Yes, can trim one of the GIFs to 30s vertical crop. Need a safe zone for text.
Samir Patel: I'll create the first comment for X with links + speaker bios + registration link (with UTMs). Will post copy for approval here.
Luca Ramirez: Quick ask — can we include a one-slide benchmark graphic showing latency vs cost on two configs? Simple bars, annotate numbers. That will live in the LinkedIn carousel and as a static on X.
Ava (Design): Got it — I'll mock the benchmark slide. Send me the numbers, Samir.
Samir Patel: Numbers: baseline (no cache): 280ms / $0.12/token; optimized (cache+batches): 110ms / $0.05/token. I'll add a short 1-line caption for annotation.
Nicole O'Neil: Also schedule an engagement follow-up: 24hrs after main post, we push an organic comment thread with a Q&A prompt and CTA to register. Tag 2 folks to help respond.
Maya Chen: Good point. @Samir and @Luca please tag in the follow-ups.
Samir Patel: Will do. I'll also prepare two question prompts: "How are you handling inference at scale?" and "What tradeoffs matter for your app?"
Luca Ramirez: One more thing: make sure the registration link respects GDPR opt-out info for EU. Legal already approved the copy last week but double-check.
Maya Chen: Thanks team — timeline recap: assets + final copy by Mon 5pm PT, design mocks by Mon 3pm PT, scheduling Wed-Thu-Fri as above. I'll confirm once everything is in and queue with the scheduler. :eyes:
